title: Characterizations of harmonic quasiregular mappings in function spaces
summary: We study conjugate-type phenomena for complex-valued harmonic quasiregular mappings in the unit disk across three function space families: $Q(n,p,α)$, $F(p,q,s)$, and the non-derivative $M(p,q,s)$. For a harmonic $K$-quasiregular mapping $f=u+iv$, we first show that if the real part $u$ belongs to $Q_h(1,p,α)$ (with $α>-1$ and $α+1<p<α+2$), the imaginary part $v$ lies in the same space with a $K$-dependent quantitative bound.
